notes.title: 1.0 UPDATE | OUT NOW🍻🎉
notes.notes:
We are incredibly excited to announce we have concluded the Early Access development of Ale Abbey and have today officially launched the full 1.0 release🍻🎉

Thank you everyone for having wishlisted us or, even better, already played the game during the EA. 

Now it’s time to show you what’s in store for the Abbey and to welcome all of you who will join us for this new phase in the brewing 🔥

[previewyoutube=bCZuZdjpOiA;full][/previewyoutube]

Official release[hr][/hr]
Build and expand your monastery, craft recipes and brew holy ales in this unique brewery tycoon. No pre-made recipes in Ale Abbey, oh no. It's a canvas for true beer alchemists. With time, you'll even be able to participate in prestigious tournaments and serve the richest tables of the region🍺

If you’re only beginning now and want some advice, check our latest tips and tricks post

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2789460/Ale_Abbey__Monastery_Brewery_Tycoon/
New content![hr][/hr]
Coming with 1.0 are four new markets, including the Grand Capital with its plush stalls and ever-thirsty patrons, eight new ale styles, a full-blown competition league, and the peaceful Contemplarium for your monks’ wellbeing. 

You’ll also find fresh furniture, expanded research, new World Events, shiny Steam Achievements, and more ways than ever to keep your abbey buzzing 🍻

If you want to check the full patch notes click below:

[expand]
v1.0(!)
New Content[hr][/hr]
Markets & Competitions 🌍 Added 4 new markets, including the majestic Capital  
 Introduced 1 new competition league  
 Added 1 new judge with updated jury preferences  
 8 new unique competition reward furniture pieces  
 New trophies to unlock and archive
Brewing & Tech 🔬 8 new ale styles now available to unlock  
 Introduced 2 new tiers of research with 16 new techs  
 New gigantic 1000-liter copper brewing tool
Rooms & Furniture 🏛️ New room: the Contemplarium, enabling meditation shifts  
 New decorative furniture: frescoes, stoves, and cellar dehumidifiers  
 Info panels added for rooms  
 Added competitions and trophies archives
World Events 📜 Introduced  6 new World Events system [spoiler](including Oktoberfest!)[/spoiler]
Bishop & Tasks ✝️ Added 3 new tasks from the Bishop
Quality of Life[hr][/hr]  
 Competition results and reward visualization added  
 Sorting enabled for monk and room lists  
 Reduced micromanagement: less cleaning and candle relighting  
 Removed cooldown from cleaning tools  
 Improved balancing for economy and difficulty  
 Increased stat impact on Fermentine work  
Steam Additions[hr][/hr]  
 56 Steam achievements added  Not available on early access save
 8 Steam trading cards available  
 Game credits now viewable
Accessibility[hr][/hr]  
 Optional colorblind mode added in settings  [/expand]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050131/57d53023f97fcbcb56738f52a1084855111db828.png

Thank you all once again![hr][/hr]
Throughout the Early Access, we’ve received a lot of feedback from you, and those helped us get the game to the point it is now. For that we want to say thank you again for shaping this beautiful Ale with us!

If you want to brag about your skills in brewing, join us directly on our Discord and see you in the Abbey!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050131/f763530fc03fa4da5f3834d05f2712f4e196b1f5.png

notes.title: The final Pour | 1.0 Release date!
notes.notes:
Hey Brewers! 

After multiple updates (and you know you asked for ‘em!), it is time for our best pints to be served! Ale Abbey’s 1.0 update releases on the 17th of September 🍺

[previewyoutube=cTQFLAvs7jk;full][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr]New content🔥

After 6 months in Early Access, Ale Abbey will be feature complete! The final touches are on their way with full release landing on September 17th. Get your paddles ready, brewers 👀

📜 The full release will include: 
 The Contemplarium, a new room for your Fermentines’ mental well-being, where you can personally schedule their shifts and much-needed meditation breaks,
 New World Events and Tasks that alter gameplay in their own very unique ways and are bound to keep your monastery buzzing,
 A new Competition League with a familiar new Judge (especially if you’re doing some extra homebrewing on the side IRL), new prizes, and unique unlockables, reserved for only the best of brews,
 New Research Nodes to buff your production and other facets of monastic life,
 Steam Achievements (yes, finally!) for every milestone worth bragging about,
 Four new markets, including the grand Capital with its affluent populace and the region's thirstiest patrons (yet!)
 Eight fresh ale styles to unlock and master,
 A wealth of new furniture and equipment (incl. Frescos and Cellar Dehumidifiers!), and
 many other additions, including new accessibility and gameplay features!Care to see more!?

Then check for Ale Abbey on your favorite socials, and make sure you mention it to your favorite content creators... Chances are they'll enjoy building their abbey😉

See you all on the 17th for the official release 🍻
- The Ale Abbey Team

notes.title: Foam and Fame Update | One week update
notes.notes:
Thank you for your participation in our Early Access!

We’ve been blown away by all the love you’ve shown since the last update! Seeing so many of you jump back into the Abbey, brewing away, and leaving kind words on Steam has been a real joy for the whole team.

You made us pass 500 reviews! That’s no small feat for a bunch of monks with questionable brewing methods in an always growing abbey. If you’ve enjoyed the latest update and haven’t dropped a review yet, we’d love to hear your thoughts. Every single one of them helps us gain some more visibility on Steam so you'd help us a lot by doing so 🍻

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2789460/Ale_Abbey__Monastery_Brewery_Tycoon/[hr][/hr]Patch notes

if you missed it, we’ve already rolled out patches v0.3.1 and v0.3.2 based on your early feedback. Most of your reports and feedback has been addressed. That's more than 2500+ in-game reports that we dealt with since the first demo release, and we're not slowing down!

These tweaks were only the beginning. With the latest patch out and fermenting nicely, our eyes are now set on what’s ahead. And trust us, there’s more brewing behind the scenes...

Stay tuned for the next batch of updates coming soon 👀

– The Ale Abbey Team

notes.title: Road to EA - Seasonal changes
notes.notes:
Hello brewers!
As you know, the release of the early access is planned soon! Let's have a look at everything coming your way! Before going to major topics, let's stop for a quick overview of what we talked about previously...Today's topic: seasonal change!
The four seasons[hr][/hr]
Starting from the Early Access, you will be able to see the evolution of the seasons impacting the abbey.
These changes will be visible and you'll be able to see the transition in real time. Have a look and let us know what you think! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050131/90d97eba8b35ee4ffe24554fb72ca1358755dbf9.gif
You'll be able to enjoy the four seasons directly from the comfort of your abbey

These seasons are not just for show (even if they are beautiful). On top of chosing specific ingredients that are related to the ongoing season, they will reduce the production cost of your beer.
So, be creative and try to experiment to get the best out of what the seasons have to offer!
